How do you transform and innovate as your company grows and matures, even as the underlying technology platform shift beneath you?

joins A16Z general partner Martin Casado, A16Z co-founder Mark Andresen, and host Zonal Choxy, on the occasion of Michael's book, Play Nice But Win, a CEO's journey from founder to leader. thesis: The episode discusses the transformation of companies through technological shifts, specifically debating the consensus view that infrastructure will consolidate into a public cloud oligopoly against Michael Dell's view that infrastructure will remain distributed across public, private, and edge environments.
